transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, hi Doctor. I guess what brings me in is... my head just feels real cloudy lately. It’s like a thick fog. Kind of like how it looked over the highway this morning, actually. I was driving over here and thinking I really should have washed my car, but the birds just make a mess of it anyway, especially those big blackbirds that sit on the power lines by my building. There must be a hundred of them out there making a racket. 

But anyway... what was I saying? Oh, right, the cloudiness. I manage a few community associations, and lately, I'll just sit at my desk and stare at a board packet or an email from a vendor, like the landscaping guys. And I just... I can't decide even the simple things anymore. Things I used to handle real fast, you know? Now I just stare. And those landscaping guys, let me tell you, if you don't stay right on top of them, they'll charge you for mulch they didn't even put down... but yeah, I just sit there looking at the screen unable to make a choice.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things as much as you used to, even activities you used to look forward to?

Well, yeah, actually. I just haven't wanted to do much of anything lately. Like my dance class... I haven't wanted to go to that at all. It's over at the community center, and the instructor, Mary, she’s been wearing this big heavy knee brace the last few months. I keep telling her she needs to take turmeric for the swelling because my sister takes it and swears by it. Course, my sister will buy just about anything they sell on those late-night TV commercials, she's got a whole cabinet full of pills and powders. 

But anyway, I just don't have the drive to go dance. And I haven't been going down to look at the little galleries either. I used to love doing that. They actually opened a new one right next to that bakery on Main Street, the one with the big blueberry muffins? Though let me tell you, lately they hardly put any blueberries in them at all, it's just plain bread and they still charge you three dollars. It's highway robbery, just like everything else these days. 

But... oh, and the cooking. I haven't even wanted to cook Sunday food for my family. And those are the things that usually make me feel like myself, you know? The dancing, the galleries, having everyone over and feeding them. Now I just don't even care to do it.
Have you been feeling tired or lacking energy most days, even when you haven’t been doing much?

Well, I don't know if I'd say I'm tired. I mean, I'm not really doing much so I don't see why I would be tired, you know? But then again, maybe I am. I did sit in my chair for a long time yesterday just watching the television. They had this whole marathon of those old westerns on. My husband used to love those, he'd watch them all Sunday afternoon. He had this old recliner that squeaked every time he moved, and I swear he'd fall asleep halfway through and then wake up right at the end and act like he saw the whole thing. He always said John Wayne was the only real actor in Hollywood. I don't know about that, but they sure don't make movies like they used to, with all the computer stuff they do now. It just looks fake to me. 

But no, I don't think I'm especially tired. Just... not really doing much, I suppose.
